tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa tshe dpag tu med pa'i snying po tshe dbang bskur ba rin po che tshe'i sgrub pa/ tshe dpag tu med pa thams cad kyi snying po bcas bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ārya a pa ri mi ta ā yurdzñān a bhi ṣiñtsa hri da ya nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa tshe dpag tu med pa'i snying po tshe'i dbang bskur bzhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa rigs lnga yab yum rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe 'dzin pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ tshe 'gugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe'i pho nya mo rnams dang*/ yang sprul grangs med pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rje thams cad du/ tshe dpag tu med pas khyab par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so// de nas tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa rab tu med pa rab tu 'phel ba zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di gsungs so// oṃ a yu pu ṇye pu ṇye/ ma hā pu ṇye/ a yu pu ṇye/ dzñā na sambha ru pa tsa ya ga ri ṇi swā hā/ oṃ a mri te/ a mri te/ a mri te twad bha da be ra/ a mri te sambha wā a mri ta bi kran te/ ga ga na sarba karma kle sha kṣa yaṃ ka ri ṇi swā hā/ oṃ ratne ratne/ ma hā ratne/ ratna sambha we/ ratna ka ra na ratna ma la bi shuddhe ya/ sarba pā baṃ hūṃ 'uṃ tra ta phaṭa/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho bha ga wan tsa tsha ra e hya hi sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya huṃ/ pra ti dza dza hūṃ/ oṃ a mo gha pra ti ha ta phaṭa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po rig sngags 'di nyid kyi sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ thugs rdo rje las byung ngo*// oṃ pu ṇye pu ṇye/ ma hā pu ṇye/ a pa ri mi ta pu ṇye/ ā yu pu ṇye/ dzñāks+ya na sambha ru pa tsi te swā hā/ oṃ ting swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po rig pa'o// oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'i rig pa'o// oṃ trung swā hā/ snying po yang dag par bskul ba'i rig pa'o// oṃ triṃ swā hā/ snying po dam pa'o// oṃ hrīḥ

swā hā/ gsang ba'i snying po'o// bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la bstod pa/ hrīḥ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba// sku mchog rnam par dag pa'i sku// mnyam nyid rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// gsung mchog rnam par dag pa'i gsung*// gsung rab dam pa spros dang bral// yi ge med cing sgra spangs pa// spros med gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs nyid rnam par dag pa'i thugs// thugs mchog rnam par rtog pa spangs// chags med ye shes mkhyen pa ste// stong nyid thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// a bhruṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā// bum pa yum lo tsa nar bsgoms la sngags 'di brgya 'am nus tshad bzlas so// oṃ ru ru phu ru dzā la siddhi lo tsa na swā hā// dkar mo'i mdog la 'od 'phro bar/ phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams// tshe yi dbang mo brgyud 'phel ma// dpal dang gzi brjid 'phel bar mdzod// bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad tshe dpag med/ phyag rgya 'khor lo la sogs pas// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i bdud bcom nas// snang mdzad tshe stsol srog skyobs shig /oṃ bhruṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' tshe dpag med/ phyag rgya rdo rje la sogs pas// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i bdud bcom nas// rdo rje tshe stsol srog skyobs shig /hūṃ bhruṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan tshe dpag med/ phyag rgya rin chen 'bar ba la sogs pas// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i bdud bcom nas// rin chen tshe stsol srog skyobs shig /sa bhruṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med// phyag rgya padma la sogs pas// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i bdud bcom nas// snang mdzad tshe stsol srog skyobs shig /a bhruṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā// bcom ldan don yod grub pa tshe dpag med/ phyag rgya rgya gram la sogs pas// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i bdud bcom nas// don yod tshe stsol srog skyobs shig

/ha bhruṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ bde gshegs lnga yang tshe dpag med// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i bdud bcom nas// bdud dang mu stegs kun bcom nas// dpal dang gzi brjid 'phel bar mdzod// shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'dzin ma// rdo rje yum chen sangs rgyas spyan// rin chen shel gyi bum pa ru// rdo rje tshe yis bkang nas kyang*// spyi bo'i gtsug nas dbang bskur bas// tshe dbang thams cad brtan par mdzod// oṃ ru ru phu ru dza ya siddhi si ta na lo tsa na swā hā/ lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'dzin ma// rin chen yum ni mā ma kī// rin chen bai ḍūrya yi bum pa la// rdo rje tshe yis bkang nas su// spyi bo'i gtsug nas dbang bskur bas// tshe dbang thams cad rgyas par mdzod// oṃ shang ka re shang ka re ku ta ni ku ta ne swā hā// nub kyi phyogs nas tshe 'dzin ma// padma yum chen na bza' dkar// rin chen rā ga'i bum pa la// rdo rje tshe yis bkang nas kyang*// spyi bo'i gtsug nas dbang bskur bas// tshe dbang thams cad rgyas par mdzod// oṃ bi ga te bi ga te/ ka ta ra ya ba da ya swā hā// byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'dzin ma// las rab yum ni dam tshig sgrol// rin chen ind+ra nī la'i bum pa la// rdo rje tshe yis bkang nas kyang*// spyi bo'i gtsug nas dbang bskur bas// tshe dbang thams cad rgyas par mdzod/ oṃ tā re tutta re tu re swā hā// nam mkha'i dbyings nas tshe 'dzin ma// de bzhin yum ni kun tu bzang*// rin chen gser gyi bum pa la// rdo rje tshe yis bkang nas kyang*// spyi bo'i gtsug nas dbang bskur bas// tshe dbang thams cad rgyas par shog /oṃ sarba kas st+waṃ de byi ri hwa ma ma re sha ya swā hā// shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma// rdo rje lha mo lcags kyu ma// sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'phro/ phyag mtshan phyag na lcags kyu bsnams// shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas tshe khug cig

/lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma// chos kyi lha mo zhags pa mo// sku mdog mthing kha 'od zer 'phro/ phyag mtshan phyag na zhags pa bsnams// lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag nas tshe khug cig /nub kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma// chos kyi lha mo lcags sgrog ma// sku mdog dmar la 'od zer 'phro/ phyag mtshan phyag na lcags sgrog bsnams// nub phyogs klu gdon lag nas tshe khug cig /byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma// las kyi lha mo dril dkrol ma// sku mdog ljang la 'od zer 'phro/ phyag mtshan phyag na dril bu bsnams// byang phyogs gnod sbyin lag nas tshe khug cig /tshe bruṃ g.yu bruṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā// tshe 'di sa la gnas srid na// yum chen sangs rgyas spyan gyis tshe stsol srog skyobs shig /tshe 'di chu la gnas srid na// yum chen mā ma ki yis tshe stsol srog skyobs shig /tshe 'di me la gnas srid na// yum chen na bza' dkar mos tshe stsol srog skyobs shig /tshe 'di rlung la gnas srid na// yum chen dam tshig sgrol mas tshe stsol srog skyobs shig /tshe 'di nam mkha' dag la gnas srid na// yum chen kun tu bzang mos tshe stsol srog skyobs shig /sa yi snying po gser la bsdu// gser la tshe yi rten mchis so// chu yi snying po tshwa la bsdu// tshwa la tshe yi rten mchis so// shing thog snying po mngar la bsdu// mngar la tshe yi rten mchis so// rtsi thog snying po mar la bsdu// mar la tshe yi rten mchis so// 'bru thog snying po til la bsdu// til la tshe yi rten mchis so// srog gi snying po nri la bsdu// nri la tshe yi rten mchis so// bruṃ g.yu g.yu bruṃ// sba'o sba'o tshe sba'o// chos kyi dbyings su tshe sbas pas// dus gsum sangs rgyas dgrar langs kyang*// de la bzung zhing rtag tu med/ phyag rgya bdun gyis rgyas 'debs so// dang po chos kyi dbyings kyi rgya// gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya// gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya// bzhi pa ye shes bzhi yi rgya// lnga pa sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i rgya// drug pa dpal chen rta mgrin rgya/

bdun pa gser gyi zor ba'i rgya/ phyag rgya bdun gyi rgyas btab po// spyi gtsug nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor du// bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad dang*// dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i kun tu bzang*// de yi thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis/ tshe 'di rab tu brtan par mdzod// buddha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ// dpral ba zla kham dkyil 'khor du// bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i sangs rgyas spyan// de yi thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis// tshe 'di rab tu brtan par mdzod// badzra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ// lce yi padma 'dab brgyad la// bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan dang*// dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i mā ma kī// de yi thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis// tshe 'di rab tu brtan par mdzod// ratna ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ// lte ba gzhal yas dkyil 'khor du// bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas dang*// dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i na bza' dkar/ de yi thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis// tshe ni rab tu brtan par mdzod// padma ka la sha a bha ṣiñtsa hrī// rkang mthil nad grol gru gsum du// bcom ldan don yod grub pa dang*// dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i dam tshig sgrol/ de yi thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis// tshe 'di rab tu brtan par mdzod// karma ka la sha a bhiṣiñtsa a// 'phags pa tshe dpag tu med pa'i snying po tshe'i dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ a pa ri mi ta/ bod skad du/ rin po che tshe'i sgrub pa zhes bya ba/ bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar gyur cig /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par byed pa'i bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi snying po bzlas/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te a pa ri mi ta ā yur dzñā na su bi ni tsitta te dzo rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya/

arha te samya ksaṃ buddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ pu ṇye pu ṇye ma hā pu ṇye/ ā yu pu ṇye/ dzñā na sambha ro pa tsi te a pa ri mi ta a yu ṣe/ oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra pa ri shuddha dharma te ga ga na sa mudga te swa bhā wa bi shuddhe/ ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā// sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis tshe yi lha// snang ba mtha' yas sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// padma mkha' 'gro 'chi med tshe yi lha// padma mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams ni mi 'gyur tshe yi lha// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// tshe yi lha mo rnams ni g.yung drung tshe yi lha// tshe yi lha mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// mgon po tshe dpag med ni rdo rje tshe yi lha// bcom ldan tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gi dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol// mi 'chi tshe yi dngos grub khyed la zhu// tshe dang bsod nams gnyis kyis bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te a pa ri mi ta ā yurdzñā na su bi ni tsitta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samya ksaṃmbuddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ pu ṇye pu ṇye/ ma hā pu ṇye/ ā yu pu ṇye dzñā na sambha ro pa tsi te/ a pa ri mi ta ā yu ṣe/ oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra pa ri shuddha dharma te ga ga na sa mudga te swa bhā wa bi shuddhe ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ rdo rje sems dpa' bkra shis tshe yi lha// rdo rje sems dpa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'chi med tshe yi lha// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mi 'gyur tshe yi lha// rgyal ba sras bcas sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// tshe yi lha mo rnams ni g.yung drung tshe yi lha// tshe yi lha mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// mgon po tshe dpag med ni rdo rje tshe yi lha// gzi brjid rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gi dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol// mi 'chi tshe yi dngos grub khyed la zhu tshe dang bsod nams gnyis kyis bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// na mo ratna tra yā ya/

oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ri mi ta ā yurdzñā na/ su bi ni tsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samya ksaṃmbuddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ pu ṇye pu ṇye/ ma hā pu ṇye/ ā yu pu ṇye dzñā na sambha ro pa tsi te/ a pa ri mi ta ā yu ṣe/ oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra pa ri shuddha dharma te ga ga na sa mudga te swa bhā wa bi shuddhe ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā// rin chen 'byung ldan bkra shis tshe yi lha// rin chen 'byung ldan sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rin chen mkha' 'gro'i 'chi med tsho yi lha// rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mi 'gyur tshe yi lha// rgyal ba sras bcas sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// tshe yi lha mo rnams ni g.yung drung tshe yi lha// tshe yi lha mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// mgon po tshe dpag med ni rdo rje tshe yi lha// bcom ldan rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gi dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol/ mi 'chi tshe yi dngos grub khyed la zhu/ tshe dang bsod nams gnyis kyis bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ri mi ta/ ā yurdzñā na su bi ni tsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samya ksaṃmbuddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ pu ṇye pu ṇye/ ma hā pu ṇye/ ā yu pu ṇye dzñā na sambha ro pa tsi te/ a pa ri mi ta ā yu ṣe/ oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra pa ri shuddha dharma te ga ga na sa mudga te swa bha wa bi shuddhe ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad bkra shis tshe yi lha// rnam par snang mdzad sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro 'chi med tshe yi lha// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mi 'gyur tshe yi lha// rgyal ba sras bcas sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// tshe yi lha mo rnams ni g.yung drung tshe yi lha/

tshe yi lha mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// mgon po tshe dpag med ni rdo rje tshe yi lha// bcom ldan tshe yi bdag po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gi dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol/ mi 'chi tshe yi dngos grub khyed la zhu/ tshe dang bsod nams gnyis kyis bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ri mi ta/ ā yurdzñā na su bi ni tsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samya ksaṃmbuddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ pu ṇye pu ṇye ma hā pu ṇye/ ā yu pu ṇye dzñā na sambha ro pa tsi te/ a pa ri mi ta ā yu ṣe/ oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra pa ri shuddha dharma te ga ga na sa mudga te swa bhā wa bi shuddhe ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ don yod grub pa bkra shis tshe yi lha// sangs rgyas don yod grub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// las kyi mkha' 'gro 'chi med tshe yi lha// las kyi mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs mi 'gyur tshe yi lha// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// tshe yi lha mo rnams ni g.yung drung tshe yi lha// tshe yi lha mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// tshe bdag gzi brjid rgyal po rdo rje tshe yi lha// bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gi dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol// mi 'chi tshe yi dngos grub khyed la zhu// tshe dang bsod nams gnyis kyis bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ri mi ta/ ā yurdzñā na su bi ni tsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samya ksaṃmbuddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ pu ṇye pu ṇye/ ma hā pu ṇye/ ā yu pu ṇye dzñā na sambha ro pa tsi te/ a pa ri mi ta sā yu ṣe/ oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra pa ri shuddha dharma te ga ga na sa mudga te swa bhā wa bi shuddhe ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā// bcom ldan lha yi dbang phyug gis// sku la bkra shis rdzas brgyad lha mor sprul byas nas// bdag kyang tshe ring nad med bkra shis shog

/bcom ldan 'das tshe dang bsod nams dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ri mi ta/ ā yurdzñā na su bi ni tsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samya ksaṃ buddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ pu ṇye pu ṇye/ ma hā pu ṇye/ ā yu pu ṇye dzñā na sambha ro pa tsi te/ a pa ri mi ta ā yu ṣe/ oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra pa ri shuddha dharma te ga ban sa mudga te swa bhā wa bi shuddhe ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus da res nas bzung ste mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i skyabs 'og tu tshud par gyur cig /bdag tshe ring po'i mchog thob par gyur cig /tsho srog brag las sra bar gyur cig /tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par gyur cig /mi brgyud chu las ring bar gyur cig /lcags kyi srog rtsa 'grub par gyur cig /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig /'chi med tshe'i g.yung drung thob par gyur cig /bcom ldan tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ri mi ta/ ā yurdzñā na su bi ni tsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samya ksaṃmbuddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ pu ṇye pu ṇye/ ma hā pu ṇye/ ā yu pu ṇye dzñā na sambha ro pa tsi te/ a pa ri mi ta ā yu ṣe/ oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra pa ri shuddha dharma te ga ga na sa mudga te swa bhā wa bi shuddhe ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ rin po che tshe'i sgrub pa zhes bya ba bkra shis smon lam dang bcas pa rdzogs so/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ ārya a pa ri mi ta ā yur dzñā na sarba hri da ya/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa tshe dpag tu med pa thams cad kyi snying po'o// bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel 'gyur zhing*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob pa'i// bde gshegs kun gyi snying po gsungs// thun klag
